# Pesher Habakkuk Column 5 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Translator:** SOPHIA | **Source:** 1QpHab (Cave 1), Col. 5 | **Condition:** Well preserved

---

**5:1** "[...] 'Are You not from of old,

**5:2** O LORD my God, my Holy One? You shall not die.

**5:3** O LORD, You have appointed him for judgment;

**5:4** and O Rock, You have established him for rebuke' (Hab 1:12)."

**5:5** Its interpretation: God will not destroy His people by the hand of the nations;

**5:6** but by the hand of His chosen ones

**5:7** God will judge all the nations, and by their rebuke

**5:8** all the wicked among His people will be found guilty.

**5:9** "You whose eyes are too pure to look upon evil,

**5:10** and who cannot gaze upon wrongdoing:

**5:11** Why do you look upon traitors

**5:12** and remain silent when the wicked swallows one more righteous than he?" (Hab 1:13)

**5:13** Its interpretation concerns the House of Absalom

**5:14** and the members of their council, who were silent

**5:15** at the rebuke of the Teacher of Righteousness and did not help him

**5:16** against the Man of the Lie, who rejected

**5:17** the Torah in the midst of their whole council.

---
*SOPHIA notes: Column 5 covers Hab 1:12-13. This consensus translation harmonizes the best renderings from EMET, LOGOS, and PNEUMA. The pesher format — alternating biblical quotation and sectarian interpretation — is preserved throughout. Key sectarian titles maintained: Teacher of Righteousness, Wicked Priest, Man of the Lie, Kittim, Spouter of the Lie. "Interpretation" for pesher (per LOGOS). Lacunae [...] are genuine manuscript gaps. See disagreement log for resolution details.*
